alerts.title: Iran war live: Tehran presses 7-day Hormuz plan; Trump denies peace talks
alerts.why: Iran pursuing a plan to reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz lowers severe supply disruption risks, sending crude prices lower.

alerts.title: Diesel Danger Zone
alerts.why: Wars hobble major diesel exporters, driving prices higher and creating tight global supplies requiring demand destruction.

alerts.title: Oil Prices Fall as Vance Moves to Restart Iran Peace Talks
alerts.why: Initiation of peace talks with Iran signals potential easing of geopolitical risk premium and supply disruption fears, pressuring Brent and WTI.

alerts.title: Tanker feared sinking off Oman after reported projectile strike
alerts.why: Suspected projectile strike on tanker near Strait of Hormuz raises major supply disruption fears in a critical global oil chokepoint.

alerts.title: UKMTO Reports Burning Tanker Off Musandam Peninsula
alerts.why: Tanker attack near the Strait of Hormuz raises immediate supply disruption fears in a critical crude chokepoint.

itemsSent.title: QatarEnergy Extends LNG Force Majeure to End of 2026
itemsSent.why: QatarEnergy extends LNG force majeure to late 2026, driving European natural gas prices to multi-year highs and boosting global gas markets.

itemsSent.title: US Oil Inventories Fall Again As Prices Rise
itemsSent.why: US crude inventories fell by 1.9 million barrels, leaving stockpiles 4% below the five-year average, supporting near-term prices.

itemsSent.title: Oil Context Weekly (W36)
itemsSent.why: Diesel cracks hit record highs while crude backwardation steepens and Middle East strikes escalate, creating divergent price pressures.

itemsSent.title: US Tells Ships to Avoid Unnecessary Transits Through Hormuz
itemsSent.why: US military advice to avoid Strait of Hormuz raises Middle East supply disruption risk, boosting Brent crude risk premium.

itemsSent.title: EIA: US crude oil inventories down 1.9 million bbl
itemsSent.why: US crude inventories fell by 1.9 million barrels, leaving stocks 4% below the 5-year seasonal average.

itemsSent.title: Bank of Canada raises interest rates for the first time in three years
itemsSent.why: Rate hike counters soaring energy inflation, slightly bearish for crude demand while reflecting strong commodity price pressures.

itemsSent.title: Global Oil Data Deck (October 2026)
itemsSent.why: Global stocks drawing down is bullish for crude, but uneven Middle Eastern exports create noise and limit immediate directional conviction.

itemsSent.title: Fed leaves interest rates unchanged despite inflation in the US
itemsSent.why: Holding rates high amid rising inflation pressures economic growth, dampening future oil demand.

itemsSent.title: NEW: Russia is actively supporting Houthi operations to disrupt global energy markets by providing the Houthis with satellite imagery of Saudi oil and military infrastructure. (1/5)
itemsSent.why: Russian intelligence sharing with Houthis threatens Saudi energy infrastructure, raising geopolitical risk premiums for crude oil.

itemsSent.title: Oil Refineries Become Prime Targets as Global Fuel Shortage Worsens
itemsSent.why: Refinery damage cuts crude demand (bearish CL) while removing finished fuels from the market, driving up product prices (bullish RB/HO).
